results.name: Earthquake in Afghanistan
results.reason: At 19:17 UTC on Sunday 31 August (23:47 local time), a magnitude 6.0 earthquake hit the province of Konarha in Afghanistan. Given its magnitude and the vulnerability of the affected population, this earthquake was expected to have a significant humanitarian impact. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping has been requested to provide emergency mapping of the earthquake's extent and damage.
